title: One (position, k) sample of a PUZ run (eval/puzzle_run.py) — see eval/EVAL-DESIGN.md §3.3. The results.jsonl file holds one of these per sample plus a final {"t":"summary", ...puzzle-run-summary.v1} line. Schema is ADDITIVE-ONLY; consumers read via .get().

profile.description: contract era this row was rendered under; puz-v2 appends the frozen legend and mints its OWN contract_sha, so rows from the two eras are different measurements and must never be pooled

k.description: 1-based sample index within the position's k resamples

strictness.description: the PRIMARY strictness this row's outcome/score used

reply.description: verbatim model reply; null == no reply obtained

outcome.description: interface_failure is NEVER scored as a wrong Magic play; it is excluded from the exclusive score denominator and rated separately

option_index.description: 0-based index into options; null == decline slot or interface failure

choice.description: harness encoding (contract §1.3): option_index, or -1 for the decline/PASS slot

score.description: answer_key.option_scores[option_index]; null on interface failure (inclusive aggregation counts it as 0, exclusive excludes it)

error.description: transport error text or 'fixture_miss'; non-null rows are missing DATA and are excluded from every scoring denominator

lenient.description: the same reply parsed leniently (the formatting-tax twin)
